Name: Modest Map Farm Cave
Author: InkubusMods
Description:
[b][size=4]UPDATED FOR STARDEW VALLEY 1.6 AND SMAPI 4.0[/size]

REQUIRES:[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI v4.0+
[*] Content Patcher v2.0+
[*]Yep. [i]That's all.[/i]
[b][size=3]
As of Starvew Valley 1.6, Modest Maps Cave no longer requires Minecart Patcher!![/size][/b][/list]

[b]OVERVIEW:[/b]
The Modest Cave Map is a redesigned Farm Cave, meant to capitalize on the space provided with the vanilla map, with a few tweaks here and there for added support.

If you would like to use my farm with a custom cave entrance, you can download them combined here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7228

The Farm Cave  includes added perks and space.
[list]
[*]Two dirt plots capable of growing in-season crops.
[*]A cleaner foundation for your mushrooms.
[*]A small ambient light to clear the darkness away.
[*]A working minecart, able to take you around town AND back!
[/list][b]
SIDE NOTES:[/b]
[list]
[*]If you like my work or have found an issue, I'd love for you to let me know under bug reports, and I'll assist you if I can!
[/list]
[b]MANUAL INSTALLATION:[/b]
Download the file.
Extract the Folder from the Zip.
Put said folder into:
﻿Steam>Steamapps>Common>StardewValley>Mods.
Load with SMAPI.
Enjoy.
